name: What is the typical timeline for a room renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a room renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a room renovation varies significantly based on the scope and complexity. A small cosmetic update, like painting and new flooring, might take 2-4 weeks. A more extensive renovation involving structural changes, plumbing, or electrical work could take 6-12 weeks or longer. Factors like material availability, permit approvals, and unforeseen issues can also impact the schedule. We provide a detailed project timeline during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovation timelines vary by scope; small projects take weeks, extensive ones months. We provide a detailed project timeline upfront.
